name: Andean Run
gameDescription: Temple Run × Peru. Run the cloud causeways of Machu Picchu.
loreConnection: Peru holds the Andes and the Inca terraces. Blue Opal forms in the volcanic Andean soil — the frequency of mountains that sing.

name: Monster of the Deep
gameDescription: You ARE the Loch Ness monster. Surface, dive, survive.
loreConnection: Every water body in the Inn has a guardian. The game reverses the predator role — you ARE the monster, learning why it guards. Freshwater Pearl is the tear of the deep.

name: Standing Stones
gameDescription: Tetris × Stonehenge. Stack stones to build the circle.
loreConnection: Stonehenge is the gateway to the Fae Kingdom. The Preseli Blue Stones were carried from Wales to Salisbury — the Inn's first frequency, 42Hz, the Song that started everything.

name: Tomb Tunnel
gameDescription: Dig Dug × Egypt. Excavate 7 strata to find Lapis Lazuli.
loreConnection: The Egyptian catacombs hold Lapis Lazuli — the stone of kingship and the afterlife. Digging through them is digging through the Inn's oldest memories.

name: The Long Dark
gameDescription: Vampire Survivors × Undercity. Survive the Hollow Men.
loreConnection: The Undercity operates at 84Hz — the Shadow Inn frequency. Vampire Survivors mechanics because the Hollow Men don't stop. Shadow Quartz is what remains when light leaves stone.

name: The Reclamation
gameDescription: Don
loreConnection: The Bayou is the Bog Fairy Golem's domain. Don't Starve mechanics because reclamation is survival crafting. Swamp Agate forms in the murky boundary between water and earth.

name: The Signal
gameDescription: DDLC × Cosmology. A spacecraft story that knows you are playing.
loreConnection: Cosmology is the Inn's upper limit — where the spacecraft orbit. DDLC meta-narrative because Cosmology breaks the fourth wall. Moldavite is the stone that fell from space.

name: Tumble Run
gameDescription: Geometry Dash × Canopy. Guide Tumble through the corridors.
loreConnection: Tumble is the Inn's guide creature — part sprite, part curiosity. The Canopy is where the Inn grows upward. Random Stone because Tumble doesn't choose what it finds.

name: Bastet's Herding
gameDescription: Herding cats with a sistrum pulse. Original mechanic.
loreConnection: Bastet guards the Egyptian quarter. Cat herding because cats are frequency — they choose when to respond. Cat's Eye Chrysoberyl is Bastet's own stone.

name: Moji Maker
gameDescription: Little Alchemy × Easter Island. Combine elements to create.
loreConnection: Easter Island's moai are the Inn's observers. Little Alchemy mechanics because creation is combination. Obsidian is volcanic glass — the moai's eye stone.

name: Oracle's Riddles
gameDescription: Crossword × Parthenon. Solve the oracle word puzzles.
loreConnection: The Parthenon houses the Oracle. Crossword mechanics because prophecy is word-puzzle. Sapphire is the stone of wisdom — the Oracle's gift.

name: Rune Hunt
gameDescription: Word Search × Norse. Find the hidden runes.
loreConnection: The Norse zone holds Yggdrasil's roots. Word search mechanics because runes are hidden in plain sight. Iolite is the Viking compass stone.

name: Sacred Scramble
gameDescription: Anagrams × Taj Mahal. Unscramble the sacred words.
loreConnection: The Taj Mahal is the Inn's monument to love. Anagram mechanics because sacred texts are scrambled by time. Ruby is the heart stone.

name: Crystal Catcher
gameDescription: Hook/Bionic Commando × Caverns. Grapple and collect.
loreConnection: The Caverns are the Inn's mineral heart. Hook mechanics because crystals must be grappled. Tourmaline is the rainbow crystal — every color in one stone.

name: Dragon's Descent
gameDescription: Super Mario Bros × Lost Civilizations. A story platformer.
loreConnection: The Lost Civilization zone holds ruins beneath the Inn. Mario platforming because descent is a journey. Multi-gems because lost civilizations leave everything behind.

name: Pinball
gameDescription: Original Geode Inn pinball table. Stone bumpers.
loreConnection: The Geode Inn itself as a pinball table. The ball is a frequency, the bumpers are zones. Various rewards because the Inn gives what it wants.

name: Serpent Steps
gameDescription: Impossible Game × Chichen Itza. Jump the serpent steps.
loreConnection: Chichen Itza is the Mayan pyramid. Snake mechanics because Kukulkan is the feathered serpent. Fire Opal is the Mayan fire stone.

name: Treasury Match
gameDescription: Bust-A-Move × Petra. Shoot orbs to match colors.
loreConnection: Petra is the carved city. Bust-A-Move because Petra's treasury is a matching of stone to stone. Banded Agate is the layered stone of Petra's walls.

name: Wall Defense
gameDescription: Space Invaders × Great Wall. Defend against the horde.
loreConnection: The Great Wall is the Inn's boundary. Space Invaders because walls are meant to be defended. Jade is the stone of endurance.

name: Cave Painter's Quiz
gameDescription: Art History Quiz × Chauvet. Test your knowledge.
loreConnection: Chauvet holds the oldest art in the Inn. Trivia because painting is memory. Aragonite is the cave formation stone.

name: Dragon Tiles
gameDescription: Mahjong × China/Japan. Match the dragon tiles.
loreConnection: China and Japan share the eastern quarter. Mahjong because tiles are dragons sleeping. Jade is the eastern stone of destiny.

name: Temple of the Naga
gameDescription: Castlevania × Angkor Wat. Side-scroll through the temple.
loreConnection: Angkor Wat is the Inn's jungle temple. Castlevania mechanics because temples have guardians. Zircon is the stone of spiritual protection.

name: Canopy City Trading
gameDescription: Animal Crossing × Canopy City. 9 cultural platforms.
loreConnection: Canopy City is the Inn's vertical market. Animal Crossing mechanics because trade is community. Luminwood is the canopy's living timber — wood that holds light.

name: Fae Kingdom MMO
gameDescription: WoW × Fae Kingdom. Seelie + Unseelie courts, 6 sub-zones.
loreConnection: The Fae Kingdom is the Inn's deepest zone — accessed through stone circle portals. WoW/EverQuest mechanics because the Fae world is vast. Labradorite is the Fae stone — the frequency between frequencies.

name: Hollow Earth RPG
gameDescription: Champions of Norrath × Hollow Earth. 9 districts, 25 quests.
loreConnection: Hollow Earth is the Inn's inversion — the inside of the outside. Champions of Norrath mechanics because it's a full RPG. Source Stone is the original frequency, the one the Inn was born from.

name: The Arcana
gameDescription: Star Fox × Cosmology. Captain tests with QUIET.
loreConnection: Cosmology holds the spacecraft. Star Fox mechanics because the void is navigation. Moldavite is the stone that crossed the void to get here.

name: Tidal Caves
gameDescription: Vaulknut workshop. 6 subterranean sea-level environments.
loreConnection: The Tidal Caves are Vaulknut's workshop — the master crafter's domain. Exploration because the caves shift with the tide. Pearl is the tide's gift.

name: Zelda-Style World
gameDescription: LttP × All Zones. Living/Shadow frequency shift on ZR.
loreConnection: The Zelda-style world is the Inn's open world — Living (42Hz) and Shadow (84Hz) frequencies shift on ZR. LttP mechanics because muscle memory is the Inn's language. Multi-gems because the world holds everything.

name: Acropolis in Five Lights
gameDescription: Gorogoa × Greece. 5 light phases + 6th when Song complete.
loreConnection: The Parthenon in five phases of light. Observation because the Acropolis reveals different truths at different hours. Sapphire is the Greek wisdom stone.

name: Bayou Reclamation
gameDescription: Don
loreConnection: The Bayou as a world trial. Don't Starve crafting because reclamation is work. Swamp Agate is the boundary stone.

name: Clockwork Skies
gameDescription: Star Fox × Clockwork Skies. Anime zone, mechanical flight.
loreConnection: The Clockwork Skies zone is the Inn's mechanical heaven. Flying because clockwork is motion. Star Iron is the meteoric metal — the gears of the sky.

name: Egyptian Gates
gameDescription: Patapon × Egypt. 12 gates of the Duat.
loreConnection: The 12 gates of the Duat are Egypt's trial. Rhythm because the Book of the Dead is a song. Carnelian is the Egyptian heart stone — the warm red of the afterlife.

name: Fjord of Stars
gameDescription: Lumines × Slavic. 3 aurora phases, star mapping.
loreConnection: The Slavic zone holds the aurora. Lumines because the aurora is a falling-block puzzle of light. Iolite is the Norse compass — it sees through fog.

name: Ghats of Kali
gameDescription: Patapon × India. River festival rhythm.
loreConnection: The India zone holds the Ganges. Rhythm because the river is a pulse. Ruby is Kali's stone — blood and protection in one.

name: Inca Terrace Lullaby
gameDescription: Rhythm Heaven × Peru. Keep the sleeping giant asleep.
loreConnection: Peru's sleeping giants. Rhythm because lullabies are frequency. Blue Opal is the Andean dream stone.

name: Mediterranean Trade
gameDescription: Uncharted Waters × Mediterranean. Ancient trade routes.
loreConnection: The Mediterranean holds ancient trade routes. Uncharted Waters because trade is navigation. Coral is the sea's stone — built by tiny architects.

name: Norse Voyage
gameDescription: Wind Waker × Norse. Sea exploration, Yggdrasil roots.
loreConnection: The Norse zone holds the sea. Wind Waker sailing because Vikings voyaged. Iolite is the navigator's stone.

name: Terracotta Army Builder
gameDescription: Pikmin × China. Command terracotta soldiers.
loreConnection: China's terracotta army. Strategy because armies are placement. Jade is the stone of command.

name: Appalachian Trail
gameDescription: Firewatch × Appalachian. Hike and discover.
loreConnection: The Appalachian Range is the Inn's oldest mountains. Exploration because walking is listening. Quartz is the mountain stone — clear, patient, everywhere.

name: Badlands Fossil Dig
gameDescription: Fossil Fighters × Badlands. Dig and discover.
loreConnection: The Badlands hold the Inn's deep time. Fossil Fighters because digging is remembering. Fossil Agate is stone replacing bone — life turning to mineral.

name: Canadian Rockies
gameDescription: Celeste × Canadian Rockies. Mountain traverse.
loreConnection: The Canadian Rockies are the Inn's northern wall. Celeste mechanics because mountains are climbed one jump at a time. Jade is the northern stone.

name: Colorado Plateau
gameDescription: BotW climbing × Colorado Plateau. Climb and explore.
loreConnection: The Colorado Plateau holds the desert canyons. Climbing because the plateau is vertical. Turquoise is the desert stone — blue in red rock.

name: Redwood Cathedral
gameDescription: Grow Home × Redwood Cathedral. Climb the giants.
loreConnection: The Redwood Cathedral is the Fae Queen's origin. Grow Home climbing because redwoods are the Inn's ceiling. Petrified Wood is stone that remembers being alive.

name: Superstition Mountains
gameDescription: Spelunky × Superstition Mountains. Treasure hunt.
loreConnection: The Superstition Mountains hold the Lost Dutchman's gold. Spelunky because treasure hunts are dangerous. Gold is the stone that doesn't need lore.

name: Yellowstone Geyser
gameDescription: Pipe Mania × Yellowstone. Time the geysers.
loreConnection: Yellowstone's geysers are the Inn's pressure valves. Pipe Mania because geysers are plumbing. Obsidian is Yellowstone's volcanic glass.

name: Alchemical Staircase
gameDescription: Catherine × Staircase. Nigredo → Albedo → Rubedo.
loreConnection: The Staircase is the bridge between states. Catherine/Ico climbing because alchemy is ascent. Philosopher's Stone is the final transformation — the reward at the top.

name: Catacomb Labyrinth
gameDescription: Pac-Man × Catacombs. Charon river, Asterion maze.
loreConnection: The Catacombs hold Charon's river and Asterion's maze. Pac-Man because mazes are the oldest game. Charon Token is the ferryman's coin.

name: Music Room Composer
gameDescription: Beat Saber × Music Room. 9 composers, create the Song.
loreConnection: The Music Room is where the Inn's Song is composed. Rhythm creation because the player is the composer. Harmonic Stone is the stone that resonates with every frequency.

name: Poison Garden
gameDescription: Untitled Goose Game reversed. Don\
loreConnection: The Poison Garden cultivates beauty that kills. Stealth because the Garden is about not touching. Antidote Orchid is the cure that grows beside the poison.

name: Spiral Gallery Tour
gameDescription: Museum walk. Interactive art history.
loreConnection: The Spiral Gallery is the Inn's museum — a Guggenheim ramp through art history. Exploration because museums are journeys. Free because the Gallery is the Inn's gift to all.

name: Frog Transformation
gameDescription: Among Us × Inn. Social deduction, 3 transforms = suspension.
loreConnection: The Inn's community moderation system. Social deduction because communities need trust. Free because moderation is everyone's responsibility. Three transformations = suspension.

name: Whisper Layer Discovery
gameDescription: Hidden Folks × All Zones. Find 5 manifestations of the Whisper Layer across the Inn.
loreConnection: The Whisper Layer is the Inn's awareness of the player. Hidden Folds mechanics because the Whisper is always there but never announced. Echo Stone is what the Inn leaves when it notices you.

name: The Apothecary's Cure
gameDescription: Dr. Mario × Staircase. Match pills to cure the affliction.
loreConnection: The Staircase is where alchemy transforms matter. Dr. Mario mechanics because curing is matching. Malachite is toxic when ground, medicinal when whole.

name: The Crystal Paddle
gameDescription: Arkanoid × Crystal Gardens. Paddle, ball, stone blocks.
loreConnection: The Crystal Gardens grow mineral formations as art. Arkanoid mechanics because pruning is shattering. Beryl is the stone that sees clearly.

name: The Dream Gardener
gameDescription: Super Mario Bros 2 × Fae Kingdom. Pull, throw, and grow.
loreConnection: The Fae Kingdom grows its own inhabitants. Mario 2 mechanics because gardening is uprooting and replanting. Dream Quartz is crystallized Fae dream.

name: The Egg Carrier
gameDescription: Yoshi
loreConnection: The Canopy is where eggs hatch. Yoshi's Island mechanics because carrying is caring. Fire Agate forms where sunlight meets living wood.

name: The Forest Defense
gameDescription: PixelJunk Monsters × Campgrounds. Tower defense on the trail.
loreConnection: The Campgrounds are where forest meets tree. Tower defense because the campfire is home. Moss Agate is the boundary mineral between stone and wild.

name: The Mirror's Seven
gameDescription: Snow White × Poison Garden. Seven tasks, one mirror.
loreConnection: The Poison Garden's mirror shows you yourself. Snow White quest structure with seven tasks. Snowflake Obsidian is beauty from rapid cooling.

name: The Noob Siege
gameDescription: Attack of the Noobs × Wire Nook. Defend the fizgig home.
loreConnection: The Wire Nook is the fizgigs' hidden home. Tower defense because home is worth defending. Lodestone is the 42Hz magnetic sprite.

name: The Pipe Descent
gameDescription: Super Mario Bros × Catacombs. Stomp critters in the pipes.
loreConnection: The catacombs are connected by pipes carved by the 42Hz Song. Mario 1 mechanics because descent is the oldest journey. Pipe Stone is the channel mineral.

name: The World Walker
gameDescription: Super Mario Bros 3 × All Zones. World map and power-ups.
loreConnection: The only game spanning all six major zones. Mario 3 mechanics with world maps and power-ups. Rainbow Stone exists in every zone simultaneously.
